zh.title: 國泰航空客機因無線電頻率錯誤遭北約戰機攔截
zh.summary: 國泰航空客機因無線電頻率錯誤導致通訊中斷，遭匈牙利戰機攔截。
body: 根據航空媒體 Simple Flying 的報導，在7月4日，一架自香港起飛並前往倫敦的國泰航空（Cathay Pacific）班機在航行期間發生了通訊中斷。在該起通訊中斷發生之後，該客機隨即遭到匈牙利的戰鬥機進行攔截。
Simple Flying 的報導進一步指出，使用錯誤的無線電頻率似乎是這起通訊中斷事件的核心問題。由於客機在航行中經歷了通訊中斷，這架國泰航空班機隨後遭到北約（NATO）的戰鬥機升空進行攔截。

en.title: Cathay Pacific Jet Intercepted by NATO Fighter Jets Due to Incorrect Radio Frequency
en.summary: Cathay Pacific flight from Hong Kong to London was intercepted by Hungarian fighter jets on July 4.
body: According to a report by the aviation media outlet Simple Flying, a Cathay Pacific flight traveling from Hong Kong to London was intercepted by Hungarian fighter jets on July 4. The interception took place after the flight experienced a loss of communication during its route.

The report from Simple Flying noted that an incorrect radio frequency appears to have been the core issue behind the communication failure. Due to this loss of communication, the Cathay Pacific jet was intercepted by NATO fighter jets, with the radio frequency error identified as the central cause of the occurrence.

zh.title: 韓國國產巡飛彈首度艦載試射失敗 國防科學研究所查明發射器缺陷
zh.summary: 韓國巡飛彈於艦載試射中墜海；初步調查指出發射器艙門錯位導致失控
body: 韓國國防科學研究所（ADD）於2026年8月28日表示，韓國兩架巡飛彈（自殺式無人機）於8月25日自釜山外海的「馬羅島號」（ROKS Marado）兩棲攻擊艦發射後數秒內墜海。此次試射為該型無人機的首次艦載測試，預計攻擊約2公里外之無人目標船隻，但首架無人機於發射後約2秒墜海，隨後進行的第二次試射亦於發射後約4秒墜毀。
根據國防科學研究所公布的初步調查結果，事故主因為艦載發射器下段機艙門出現偏差錯位。該發射裝置包含雙層發射管，其中下層發射管左側門出現輕微錯位。當無人機從上層發射管發射時，發射過程產生的推力短暫將錯位的艙門推向內部，進而導致離開發射管的無人機受力不均，強烈向右偏轉並迅速失去控制。艙門在變形後迅速恢復原狀，致使事故發生後的初步檢查難以察覺該異常。
國防科學研究所指出，無人機本身及整體系統運作皆完全正常，並表示發射管結構問題並未在先前的測試中出現。在此次海上試驗前，該系統已在陸上成功完成約30次發射測試。調查人員目前正進一步釐清發射器門板錯位究竟發生於組裝階段、運輸過程，抑或是彈藥裝填操作期間。
此次參與測試的無人機屬於韓國自主研發的國產長程巡飛彈「K-LUCAS」計畫。該機型翼展約為3公尺，具備超過10小時的空中滯空能力，可執行偵察、監視與打擊等多元任務。韓國國防部長安圭伯（Ahn Gyu-back）曾於2026年6月宣佈，軍方計劃加速部署K-LUCAS系統。韓國目標於2030年前取得超過2萬架各型低成本無人機，並推動具備人工智慧功能的無人機蜂群技術。

en.title: South Korean Attack Drones Crash in Naval Test Due to Launcher Door Defect
en.summary: South Korea attack drones crash during naval test off Busan; launcher defect blamed for control loss
body: South Korea's Agency for Defense Development (ADD) announced on August 28, 2026, that two South Korean loitering munitions crashed into the sea seconds after launch during their first naval test on August 25. The test took place aboard ROKS Marado, a 14,000-ton Dokdo-class amphibious assault ship operating off Busan, South Korea. The mission was designed to demonstrate shipboard launch capabilities and target an unmanned vessel approximately two kilometers away. However, the first drone plunged into the sea roughly two seconds after departure, and a second drone crashed about four seconds after launch.

Preliminary investigation by the Agency for Defense Development revealed that the failures were caused by a defect in the shipboard launcher's lower tube door. The launch system utilizes a two-level tube design. According to investigators, a door on the left side of a lower launch tube was slightly out of alignment. When a drone launched from an upper tube, operational forces temporarily pushed the misaligned door inward, generating uneven aerodynamic forces on the exiting aircraft. This imbalance forced the drone sharply to the right and caused an immediate loss of flight control.

Investigators emphasized that the drones and their core operational systems functioned normally throughout the test procedure. The Agency for Defense Development stated that the identical launch tube configuration had been successfully operated during approximately 30 prior land-based trials without encountering similar structural issues. Current investigative efforts are focused on determining whether the door misalignment originated during factory assembly, transport logistics, or ammunition loading operations.

The aircraft tested belong to South Korea's K-LUCAS project, an effort to develop a domestically manufactured long-range loitering munition. Featuring a wingspan of approximately three meters, the K-LUCAS system is designed to sustain flight for more than 10 hours while executing reconnaissance, surveillance, and precision strike operations. South Korean Defense Minister Ahn Gyu-back announced in June 2026 that the military plans to accelerate the operational deployment of K-LUCAS as part of a strategic initiative to acquire over 20,000 low-cost drones by 2030.

zh.title: 捷克Zuri發表無人貨運傾轉旋翼機並籌措A輪資金
zh.summary: 捷克Zuri發表混合動力無人貨運傾轉旋翼機；現正進行A輪600萬歐元融資
body: 捷克研發業者 Zuri 於 2026 年 8 月 27 日正式發表一款用於貨運運輸的新型混合動力無人傾轉旋翼機。該款飛行器專為民用與軍用雙重用途設計，具備載重超過 165 公斤的貨運能力，巡航速度最高可達每小時 220 公里。
在操作與動力系統方面，該無人機採用由地面操作員進行遠端控制的機制，並結合多項自動化飛行程序。動力架構上，飛行器未單純依賴電池組，而是配置能在飛行過程中發電的電動馬達，並結合可使用航空汽油（AvGas）、車用汽油或生物乙醇的熱機系統，提升在複雜環境下的運作韌性。

總部位於捷克布拉格的 Zuri 由企業家 Michal Illich 創立，自 2018 年起致力於電動垂直起降（eVTOL）飛行器的研發。團隊迄今已製造並測試約 15 架不同規格的原型機，其中「Technology Demonstrator 1.0」曾於 2021 年完成受控懸停測試。目前該公司正在推進名為「Technology Demonstrator 2.0」的全尺寸原型機，並已在捷克基地展開地面測試。
為將全尺寸原型機推向飛行測試階段，Zuri 目前正在進行 A 輪融資，目標募集 600 萬歐元新資金。該公司指出，目前已獲得約 110 萬歐元的認購意向承諾，而先前已從私人投資者手中累積募集約 650 萬歐元資金。
Zuri 預計這款傾轉旋翼機能夠滿足民用與軍用客戶的多元需求，未來可執行包括離岸平台物資補給以及軍事基地運送等任務。報導提及，此項消息由媒體 AeroTime 發布。

en.title: Czech Startup Zuri Unveils Hybrid-Electric Cargo Tiltrotor Drone
en.summary: Czech startup Zuri unveiled a hybrid-electric cargo tiltrotor drone and is seeking Series A funding.
body: Czech eVTOL developer Zuri unveiled a new hybrid-electric uncrewed tiltrotor designed for cargo transportation on August 27, 2026. Built with dual-use applications in mind for both civilian and military operators, the aircraft is capable of carrying a payload exceeding 165 kilograms and reaching cruise speeds of up to 220 km/h.

The uncrewed aircraft is designed to be operated remotely by a ground control station, featuring automated flight management systems. Rather than relying solely on battery power, the tiltrotor incorporates an electric motor capable of generating electricity during flight, combined with a thermal engine capable of running on aviation gasoline (AvGas), automotive gasoline, or bioethanol to enhance power architecture resilience.

Based in Prague, Zuri was founded in 2018 by entrepreneur Michal Illich to develop electric vertical takeoff and landing technology. The startup has designed and test-flown approximately 15 different prototypes to date. Its Technology Demonstrator 1.0 previously achieved controlled hovering flight in 2021, and the company is currently advancing its full-scale Technology Demonstrator 2.0 prototype, which has already undergone initial ground testing in the Czech Republic.

To transition the Technology Demonstrator 2.0 prototype to the flight test stage, Zuri is currently raising €6 million in fresh capital through a Series A funding round. The Czech developer confirmed it has already secured €1.1 million in funding commitments, adding to the €6.5 million previously raised from private investors.

Zuri anticipates that the tiltrotor will serve both commercial and defense sectors, conducting logistics resupply operations for offshore platforms and remote military outposts, according to reporting by AeroTime.

zh.title: 紐西蘭總理公開批評紐航業績表現 紐航財年稅後虧損達2.42億紐元
zh.summary: 紐西蘭總理批評紐航年度財報表現；航司受燃油與引擎成本影響虧損2.42億紐元。
body: 紐西蘭航空（Air New Zealand）公布最新財年財務報告，顯示公司稅後淨虧損約1.44億美元（相當於2.42億紐元），稅前虧損則達約2億美元（相當於3.36億紐元）。相較之下，該航司在2025財年的稅前盈餘約為9,700萬美元（相當於1.64億紐元）。儘管面臨虧損，紐西蘭航空表示，此結果仍略優於2026年5月向市場提供的預測區間。
紐西蘭總理克里斯多福·盧克森（Christopher Luxon）對紐西蘭航空的財務表現提出公開批評，稱該航司在過去一個財年的表現「相當糟糕」。身為紐西蘭航空前執行長的盧克森指出，航司需要非常快速地恢復正常運作，並強調紐西蘭航空有責任向外界說明造成如此重大虧損的原因，以及未來將採取何種措施以打造更具競爭力的營運體質。

針對虧損原因，紐西蘭航空指出，主要因素包括中東衝突引發的航空燃油價格飆升、持續上升的航空系統成本，以及今年特別高昂的維修費用。此外，供應商引擎供應問題也嚴重衝擊營運。根據航司說明，勞斯萊斯（Rolls-Royce）Trent 1000與普惠（Pratt & Whitney）PW1100引擎的持續性問題，因運能損失、額外租賃與引擎費用、機隊利用率降低及營運效率下降等因素，對財務結果造成估計約1.9億美元的衝擊。
紐西蘭航空執行長尼基爾·拉維尚卡爾（Nikhil Ravishankar）表示，過去一年對航空業而言極具挑戰性。不過他同時指出，先前限制航司航網擴充的引擎問題目前已大幅緩解，團隊與引擎製造商緊密合作，使停飛的客機比預期更早恢復服務。雖然仍有殘餘風險與成本需要應對，但航司進入2027財年時將擁有顯著更為可靠的機隊狀況。
面對未來展望，紐西蘭航空發言人表示，鑑於中東衝突持續帶來的不確定性，以及航空燃油價格維持在高位與劇烈波動（目前燃油價格約為每桶150美元），航司目前無法針對2027財年提供盈餘指引。航司強調，先前已透過調整票價與縮減運能採取快速且果斷的行動，以平衡旅客負擔能力並最大化營運復甦。

en.title: NZ Prime Minister Scolds Air New Zealand Over Financial Loss Driven by Engine and Fuel Costs
en.summary: Air New Zealand reports NZD 242 million net loss amid fuel price hikes and engine issues.
body: Air New Zealand has posted a net loss after taxation of approximately $144 million (NZD $242 million) for the financial year, alongside a pre-tax loss of roughly $200 million (NZD $336 million). The earnings result contrasts with a pre-tax profit of around $97 million ($164 million) recorded in the previous 2025 financial period. Despite the losses, the airline noted that the final financial outcome was slightly better than the market guidance range previously issued in May 2026.

New Zealand Prime Minister Christopher Luxon, who previously served as the Chief Executive Officer of Air New Zealand, publicly criticized the carrier's financial results, describing the performance over the past financial year as very poor. Luxon stated that the airline must address its operational performance rapidly and urged management to clearly explain the underlying factors behind the substantial loss alongside plans to build a stronger business.

According to Air New Zealand, the financial headwinds were driven primarily by sharp spikes in jet fuel prices linked to the conflict in the Middle East, alongside higher aviation system and maintenance expenses. Furthermore, ongoing technical and availability issues involving Rolls-Royce Trent 1000 and Pratt & Whitney PW1100 engines impacted the annual result by an estimated $190 million through lost capacity, supplemental leasing expenses, reduced fleet utilization, and operational inefficiencies.

Air New Zealand Chief Executive Officer Nikhil Ravishankar described the period as a very challenging year for the aviation sector but noted that network constraints linked to engine availability are now substantially behind the carrier. Ravishankar highlighted that operational teams worked with engine suppliers to return grounded aircraft to active service earlier than initially anticipated, positioning the fleet for improved operational reliability entering the 2027 financial year.

Looking ahead, Air New Zealand announced that it is currently unable to provide financial earnings guidance for the 2027 financial year. An airline spokesperson cited ongoing uncertainty surrounding regional geopolitical conflicts and significant volatility in jet fuel prices, which have reached around $150 per barrel, as the primary reasons for withholding forward guidance.

zh.title: DiscoverAirlines將於2027年首航英國與愛爾蘭
zh.summary: Discover Airlines將於2027年夏季首度開闢五條往返英愛之新航線。
body: 漢莎航空（Lufthansa）旗下全資子公司 Discover Airlines 宣布將於2027年夏季首度開航往返英國與愛爾蘭的航線。該公司計畫自2027年3月起開闢每週六班往返其法蘭克福國際機場（FRA）總部與格拉斯哥（GLA）的航線；隨後於4月開航每週一班至愛爾蘭宣農（SNN）、5月每週兩班至布里斯托（BRS），以及6月每週一班至因弗內斯（INV）。
此外，該公司亦計畫自2027年5月16日起開闢每週兩班往返慕尼黑機場（MUC）與格拉斯哥（GLA）的航線。上述服務均採用空中巴士A320（ICAO機型代碼A320）客機執飛。Discover Airlines 於2023年由 Eurowings Discovery 更名，目前正推動擴張計畫，預計至2028年機隊規模將達40架。

en.title: Discover Airlines Announces First Routes to UK and Ireland for Summer 2027
en.summary: Discover Airlines will launch its first flights to the UK and Ireland in Summer 2027.
body: Discover Airlines, a wholly owned subsidiary of the Lufthansa Group, has announced four new nonstop routes linking the UK and Ireland to Germany for Summer 2027. Beginning in March 2027, the airline will fly six times weekly from Frankfurt International Airport (FRA) to Glasgow (GLA). It will follow with weekly flights to Shannon (SNN) in April, twice-weekly flights to Bristol (BRS) in May, and weekly flights to Inverness (INV) in June.

Additionally, starting May 16, 2027, Discover Airlines will launch twice-weekly flights between Munich (MUC) and Glasgow (GLA). All services are to be operated by Airbus A320 (ICAO type code A320) aircraft. Rebranded from Eurowings Discovery in 2023, the carrier plans to expand its fleet to 40 aircraft by 2028.

zh.title: REGENT完成2.4億美元B輪融資 總籌資達3.4億美元
zh.summary: REGENT完成2.4億美元B輪融資；資金將用於載具載人首飛與量產
body: REGENT Craft 於 2026 年 8 月 27 日宣布完成 2.4 億美元的 B 輪融資，該筆資金包含等額的股權與債權。本輪融資由 Mare Liberum 與 AE Ventures 領投，原有投資者如 Founders Fund、Caffeinated Capital、Lockheed Martin Ventures、日本航空及 Giant Step Capital 也參與投資。債權部分由 Palmer Luckey 創辦的 Erebor Bank 安排。
此輪融資使 REGENT Craft 的總籌資額從約 1 億美元增加至 3.4 億美元。新資金將用於支援載人首飛計劃（針對最多可載 12 人的 Viceroy Seaglider 翼地效應載具）、啟動羅德島州新廠的工業化生產，並推動 Squire 無人翼地效應載具等國防項目。

en.title: REGENT Craft Closes $240M Series B Round to Advance Seaglider Development
en.summary: REGENT Craft closes a $240 million Series B round to support seaglider flight tests and production.
body: REGENT Craft announced on August 27, 2026, that it has closed a $240 million Series B funding round consisting of equal parts equity and debt. Led by Mare Liberum and AE Ventures, the round also received support from existing investors including Founders Fund, Caffeinated Capital, Lockheed Martin Ventures, Japan Airlines, and Giant Step Capital. The debt portion was arranged by Palmer Luckey's Erebor Bank.

The new capital more than doubles REGENT Craft's total funding to date, increasing it from around $100 million to $340 million. According to the company, these funds will support upcoming milestones, including the first human flight of its 12-passenger Viceroy Seaglider, the start of manufacturing at its facility in Rhode Island, and defense projects such as the Squire unmanned seaglider.
